summary: Frontend read-only test of Super Admin /piattaforma SectionSwitch (Organizzazioni | Utenti | Abbonamenti). All acceptance criteria verified: switch container with correct data-testid, three buttons present, default Organizzazioni selected (aria-selected=true), content swaps without full navigation, ?sezione= URL param set, Utenti shows platform-users-page + platform-accounts + 32 impersonate buttons, Abbonamenti shows saas-admin-page + saas-tab-orgs + saas-tab-config + saas-max-users-bronze editor. Persistence confirmed via sessionStorage (Abbonamenti still selected after navigating to /audit and back). ?sezione=utenti on reload persists Utenti. /piattaforma/utenti and /piattaforma/abbonamenti correctly redirect to /piattaforma?sezione=... . Sidebar no longer contains 'Gestione Utenti' or 'Abbonamenti' entries. Mobile 390px: switch visible (x=16,width=307), no horizontal overflow (sw=cw=390). Read-only: no save/delete/impersonate actions were invoked.
critical_code_review_comments: Platform.jsx is ~325 lines and still mixes 3 concerns (orgs listing, FIC/Brevo integration cards, embedded Users/SaasAdmin). Consider extracting Brevo card and FIC card into dedicated components to keep file under ~250 lines.
sez initial computation reads sessionStorage/searchParams inline on every render; acceptable but could be useState initializer to avoid redundant work.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SectionSwitch implementation at /app/frontend/src/pages/Platform.jsx lines 14-23; redirects at /app/frontend/src/App.js lines 155 and 165; PLATFORM_NAV in Layout.jsx no longer has utenti/abbonamenti entries. All data-testids match request. 16 organizations exist in DB; the row-count test ran before the async fetch resolved so count showed 0 — not a bug (stats card showed 16).
